review_notes: I read the whole file and searched Mathlib for related declarations. The file does not add a competing version of an existing concept. It builds an equivalence between two existing concepts, DifferentialObject over GradedObjectWithShift and HomologicalComplex with ComplexShape.up'. Both concepts already existed, and the file links them instead of duplicating either. objEqToHom is a small abbrev that specialises eqToHom to the object function of a differential object. It exists to help the simplifier and has no Mathlib counterpart with the same role. HomologicalComplex.d_eqToHom resembles the existing HomologicalComplex.d_comp_eqToHom and eqToHom_comp_d in Mathlib/Algebra/Homology/HomologicalComplex.lean. Those are relation-based theorems with different hypotheses, and the rubric excludes standalone theorem duplication anyway. I found no concrete cost from duplicated API.
